title: Putting it together: a storage design in 5 minutes

kcs.statement: A storage answer names, for each main entity, the store type, replication mode, shard key and consistency level, deriving each from the access pattern, read-to-write ratio and storage estimate.
Each storage choice is stated with one trade-off it accepts, for example 'asynchronous replication: low write latency, may lose the last seconds of writes if the leader fails'.
Shard only when the storage estimate or write QPS exceeds what one replicated leader can hold or absorb; below that, a single leader with read replicas is simpler and keeps joins and transactions.

problem_ideas: URL shortener: 100M new URLs/month, 100:1 reads: write the full four-part storage design in 5 minutes

Critique a given design that shards a 50 GB table across 32 nodes
